fluff.overview: The Manei Domini field cybernetically enhanced infantry whose augmentations place them well beyond the capability of any conventional soldier, blurring the line between human combatant and war machine. Domini jump infantry combine cybernetic enhancement with jump capability, creating small assault teams that can drop onto elevated positions and engage with augmented strength and targeting. Their cybernetic eyes provide targeting data that conventional jump troops lack. Carrying infantry-portable machine guns that provide sustained suppressive fire, these troops anchor defensive positions with a volume of fire that discourages enemy movement in the open.
